scope.market_definition: The cut flower packaging market encompasses products and services designed to protect and present cut flowers during transportation and retail. FloraFlex® manufactures and supplies commercial-grade cultivation products at scale. Our focus is
simple: delivering consistent quality, dependable availability, and competitive pricing for
professional supply chains.

Over the past decade, FloraFlex® has grown into a large-scale manufacturer serving resellers and
commercial cultivators who require pallet and truckload volumes. Today, our business is built around
that strength: disciplined manufacturing, focused product assortments, and partner-first
distribution.

### Engineered In-House

We design and manufacture everything ourselves to ensure top-tier quality and reliability. With full
control from concept to production, FloraFlex® delivers components built to perform every grow,
every time.

### Next-Gen Lighting

FloraFlex® LEDs provide full-spectrum power with cooler temps and lower energy use. Engineered for
efficiency and yield, our lights are trusted by growers aiming for consistent, high-performance
results.

### Complete Grow Solutions

From nutrients to lighting, coco to irrigation—FloraFlex® offers everything your grow needs. Our
full system is designed to work together seamlessly, simplifying your setup while maximizing your
success.

# A better way to floral

Beautiful plants, tailored to your store, delivered on time.

[Contact Sales][11]
[.]
[.]

Success in floral is a delicate dance with a vulnerable product. There’s a lot riding on the people
you trust. You need partners who can deliver on consistency, speed and selection.

At Flora Pack, we’re dedicated to being your complete partner, helping you run a thriving department
with confidence and peace of mind.

"Flora Pack always delivers top-quality products. I can always count on friendly interactions and
timely responses."
[.]
[.]
[.]

## Reliable Quality

### Showcase plants your customers will love, everytime

Your customers expect the best, so we partner with the best. Our home-grown product comes from the
most reputable breeders and farms in our area. When we source additional products from our partner
growers, we work with those who meet our strict standards for genetics and growing practices. With
rigorous quality checks and trusted delivery, every shipment arrives as promised. Confidently sell
the plants your customers will keep coming back for, season after season.

[.]

## Responsive Communication

### Get the answers you need, when you need them

In your fast-paced world, answers can’t wait. We keep you informed with timely updates and clear
communication from a team with decades of expertise. Whether you’re confirming availability,
clarifying timelines, or planning your next shipment, you’ll have the insights you need to make
quick, confident decisions — no chasing required.

[.]

## Customized Programs

### Drive sales with fresh offerings

Each season is a new opportunity to wow your customers. Whether it’s crafting holiday displays or
curating the perfect seasonal mix, we help you keep things fresh and grab attention. With an
in-house product development team and strong supplier relationships, count on us to deliver a
program that meets your needs — right down to the last detail.

[Contact Sales][12]
"I reached out to Flora Pack because I am impressed by [their] reputation for delivering
high-quality floral packaging solutions and [their] commitment to innovation in the industry. As a
Senior Floral Merchandiser, I am always looking for ways to enhance our floral presentation and
ensure that our products reach customers in optimal condition."
[Left] [Right]

### Stunning plants for special celebrations

Every season tells a story, and every occasion deserves its moment to shine. With Flora Pack, keep
your displays fresh and exciting with tailored programs and a variety of lines that make each event
memorable.

#### Request our complete product catalogue

### Access the best of the Niagara region, from anywhere in the U.S.

Flora Pack proudly supplies Niagara’s vibrant flowers and plants to retailers and wholesalers across
North America.

[.]

## About Flora Pack

### Partnering with you to bring beauty to every moment

We’re passionate about enriching lives through the beauty of flowers and plants — celebrating
milestones, offering comfort, and brightening everyday life. As your complete floral partner, we’re
here to make your job easier and invite you to join us in sharing this beauty with the world.

[Meet Our Team][15]

### Get ready for your next season… today

Contact our sales staff by phone or by completing the form below. We’ll get to know your needs,
guide you through our product range and help you secure the ideal selection for your store.

We’re looking forward to working with you!

most reputable breeders and farms in our area. When we source additional products from our partner

rigorous quality checks and trusted delivery, every shipment arrives as promised. Confidently sell
the plants your customers will keep coming back for, season after season.

quick, confident decisions — no chasing required.

# Welcome to FloraLife

For 85 years and counting, FloraLife has been the flower care experts and worldwide leader in
postharvest flower care and handling. Since the invention of the first flower food in 1938, we’ve
continued to partner with our clients to address specific quality concerns and create a line of
floral care products formulated specifically to feed, hydrate, nourish and protect at every level of
the distribution chain. As a globally positioned company, we are proud to offer our expertise,
consultation and education to anyone in the floral industry seeking the knowledge and tools
necessary to provide the freshest and longest lasting flowers to their customers.

FloraLife is a division of Smithers-Oasis Company, a globally positioned company dedicated to the
innovation and needs of the floral industry worldwide. As a true one-stop shop, we aim to provide
the products, services and continued education that enables our customers to maximize the longevity
of their floral products and designs.

**We help our customers exceed their consumers’ expectations, providing positive experiences that
elevate the industry and generate repeat purchases.**

[Floralife is for Sustainable living]
Find Out More Expand

It has never been as important as it is today to track and reduce our footprint on the planet.
Growing, processing and distributing flowers use many resources to guarantee that high quality,
beautiful fresh cut flowers reach the hands of consumers. At FloraLife, we have focused our
sustainability plan on 5 key commitments to reduce our impact on the planet and help all our
partners, big and small, reduce theirs too. The 5 commitments are climate change, water stewardship,
product portfolio, sustainable packaging and stakeholder awareness.

Floral industry waste impacts almost all areas of sustainability. Putting measures in place to
reduce it should be top of mind. Every stem requires land to grow, water to hydrate, products to
treat, energy to cool, packaging to protect, fuel to ship and lots of labor. When a flower does not
make it to the end consumer, it is not only the flower that is wasted. It is also all the resources
that went into growing, packaging, protecting and shipping it through the long chain. Having the
proper flower care and handling protocols in place not only ensures that you put top quality flowers
in the hands of consumers, but it also can significantly reduce waste which in turn reduces your
footprint on the planet.

Together, we can make a bigger difference!

accessible for your educational needs. Our experts can be on-site to conduct care and handling,

purchaser, and a growing educated consumer base means a growing floral industry!

Success in floral is a delicate dance with a vulnerable product. There’s a lot riding on the people
you trust. You need partners who can deliver on consistency, speed and selection.

At Flora Pack, we’re dedicated to being your complete partner, helping you run a thriving department

### Showcase plants your customers will love, everytime

Your customers expect the best, so we partner with the best. Our home-grown product comes from the
most reputable breeders and farms in our area. When we source additional products from our partner
growers, we work with those who meet our strict standards for genetics and growing practices. With
rigorous quality checks and trusted delivery, every shipment arrives as promised. Confidently sell
the plants your customers will keep coming back for, season after season.

In your fast-paced world, answers can’t wait. We keep you informed with timely updates and clear
communication from a team with decades of expertise. Whether you’re confirming availability,
clarifying timelines, or planning your next shipment, you’ll have the insights you need to make
quick, confident decisions — no chasing required.

Each season is a new opportunity to wow your customers. Whether it’s crafting holiday displays or
curating the perfect seasonal mix, we help you keep things fresh and grab attention. With an
in-house product development team and strong supplier relationships, count on us to deliver a
program that meets your needs — right down to the last detail.

ensure that our products reach customers in optimal condition."

# Welcome to FloraLife

For 85 years and counting, FloraLife has been the flower care experts and worldwide leader in
postharvest flower care and handling. Since the invention of the first flower food in 1938, we’ve
continued to partner with our clients to address specific quality concerns and create a line of
floral care products formulated specifically to feed, hydrate, nourish and protect at every level of
the distribution chain. As a globally positioned company, we are proud to offer our expertise,
consultation and education to anyone in the floral industry seeking the knowledge and tools
necessary to provide the freshest and longest lasting flowers to their customers.

FloraLife is a division of Smithers-Oasis Company, a globally positioned company dedicated to the
innovation and needs of the floral industry worldwide. As a true one-stop shop, we aim to provide
the products, services and continued education that enables our customers to maximize the longevity
of their floral products and designs.

**We help our customers exceed their consumers’ expectations, providing positive experiences that
elevate the industry and generate repeat purchases.**

accessible for your educational needs. Our experts can be on-site to conduct care and handling,
proper practices and protocols, as well as merchandising training. We present monthly webinars,
publish research papers and educational articles, and speak at industry events.

pride ourselves in is the Flower Food for Thought® program… because an educated consumer is a repeat

all of North America's largest Chain Store Retailers, Floral, and Food companies.

### Pricing

Many customers contract with A-ROO for creating concepts, logos, drawings, marketing materials, etc.
A-ROO charges a fee of $75/hour for art preparation. The Creative Department can provide an hourly
estimate regarding the estimated time the project will take to create. Customers can expect
professional quality renderings and fast turn-around time.

We offer high-quality flexographic and rotogravure printing for bags and sleeves on both plastic
films and paper. We print full-color process plus up to 10 Spot Colors in-house.

### Convenience

A-ROO Company has invested heavily in-stock standard products that our customers have come to rely
upon for their immediate availability. We stock more standard packaging than any other floral
packaging company in the Western Hemisphere, and we maintain warehouses at four US locations.

### Reliability

This allows us to offer consistent stock / standard item availability and inventory services for
custom products. Contact an A-ROO Company Sales Professional about warehousing and inventory

distributor of high-quality, innovative floral packaging products to the North and South American

packaging, food packaging, and accessories. These include Sheets and Sleeves for fresh cut flowers

# Corrugated cardboard packaging specialists

## Welcome to Smurfit Westrock Atlas

We are a UK packaging company making a wide range of corrugated cardboard packaging from our base in
Devon. We pride ourselves on delivering competitive prices, clear quotations and excellent service.
To do this we have in house award winning [structural and graphic design teams][21] and state of the
art production equipment.

Corrugated cardboard boxes are a great solution for eCommerce or home delivery packaging as they are
a [sustainable choice for the planet][22], are durable enough to cope in transit and are printed for
an amazing brand experience.

# Welcome to Custom Converting!

## **Custom Converting, Inc. (CCI) is an ISO 9001/2015 Certified contract manufacturer of custom
## parts and components.**

Custom Converting is a 3M Select Converter and specializes in converting, precision slitting, rotary
die cutting, assembly and packaging services, and manufacturing products for businesses throughout
the U.S. and Worldwide. Custom Converting, Inc. (CCI) is an ISO 9001:2015 Certified contract
manufacturer of custom parts and components. Custom Converting, Inc. has been in business since 1983
and is located in Oceanside, California, in San Diego County.

We partner with manufacturing and design engineers, purchasing agents, and production personnel in
providing unique and cost effective manufacturing solutions that meet their needs. We also provide
technical consultation for product design, and the design of effective manufacturing processes. Our
facility is registered with the FDA and we manufacture to cGMP specifications.

Our manufacturing capabilities include
* Precision Die Cutting
* Pouching Services
* Multi-Layer Laminating
* Close Tolerance Slitting
* Assembly and Packaging
* In-line Print

# Reliable, Knowledgeable, & Trustworthy

**3M Select Converter status is a quality certification awarded by 3M Converter Solutions. It is a
difficult qualification to obtain and means that our company is reliable, knowledgeable, and
trustworthy.**

As an authorized 3M™ Select Converter, Fabricator, and Distributor, we remain on the cutting edge of
what’s new in terms of products and processes. We continuously delve into new ways to create
products that meet each customer’s needs. Our versatility and capabilities enable us to die cut
pressure-sensitive adhesives to your exact specifications. We have access to all 3M products, new
technologies, specialists and support to meet your needs.

Welcome to Krueger Wholesale Florist, a dynamic, family owned and operated company, committed to
providing our customers with the highest quality products and best service in the industry.

grown to become one of the largest floral distribution companies in the Midwest. Our modern 150,000
square foot corporate headquarter and distribution center is supplemented by an additional satellite
facility and its own logistics division, KW Transit.

selection of fresh cut flowers and greens, stunning botanicals and a vast array of floral
supplies. [Learn more about the Krueger Difference!][9]

# Premium Dutch Floral & Decorative
# Importer & Exporter

From fresh cut flowers to refined decorative collections — delivered across Europe with precision,
consistency and market expertise.

[Request Availability][6]
[Dutch tulip fields]

## About MH Flowers

MH Flowers is a Netherlands-based export partner supplying wholesalers, retailers and garden centers
throughout Europe with premium floral and decorative products.

We collaborate closely with trusted growers, nurseries and manufacturers to guarantee quality
control, freshness and stable supply chains. Our approach combines Dutch market expertise with
efficient export logistics tailored to professional buyers. We continuously monitor market trends to
ensure competitive sourcing and product availability throughout the year. Every shipment is handled
with precision and care, reflecting our commitment to long-term business relationships.

## Our Product Divisions

A complete portfolio designed for professional buyers seeking consistency, seasonal innovation and
premium presentation across multiple categories.

### Cut Flowers

Premium roses, tulips and seasonal varieties sourced daily from Dutch auctions and selected growers.

### Garden Plants

Outdoor nursery plants, shrubs and specialty selections for garden centers and landscaping
professionals.

### Home & Indoor Plants

Stylish indoor greenery collections curated for retail chains and interior-focused concepts.

### Floral Arrangements

Ready-made bouquets and custom floral compositions prepared according to market demand.

### Decorative Vases

Glass, ceramic and contemporary design vases complementing modern floral presentations.

### Seasonal Decorations

Holiday and seasonal decorative collections tailored specifically for European retail markets.

## Export & Logistics

Our logistics network ensures temperature-controlled transport throughout Europe, maintaining
freshness and product integrity from grower to destination.

We operate with flexible volumes, consolidated shipments and customized packaging solutions adapted
to each client’s operational needs.

Reliable scheduling. Transparent pricing. Long-term partnerships.
Seamless cross-border transport. Quality assurance at every stage. Built on trust and performance.
Trusted by professionals across Europe.
[Flower Logistics & Transport]

## Partner With MH Flowers

Contact us for weekly availability lists, tailored pricing structures and export conditions adapted
to your market.

# A Global Leader in Modified Atmosphere Packaging Solutions for Fresh Produce

From berries to beans and fresh cuts, our proprietary modified atmosphere packaging technology
creates the optimal conditions for your high-value produce. As a leading produce packaging supplier
specializing in fresh produce shelf life extension, we help you extend market reach, reduce supply
chain waste, and deliver exceptional freshness; all backed by 30+ years of material science
innovation and postharvest expertise.

## We transform how specialty produce reaches the world. Fresher. Sustainably. Profitably.

## Explore StePacPPC’s Technology & Expertise

Our patented modified atmosphere (MA) and modified humidity (MH) films do what standard packaging
cannot — control both gas composition and moisture levels to slow down aging and ripening processes,
inhibit microbial decay and maintain quality. With decades of combined postharvest experience across
60+ produce types, we engineer solutions tailored to your specific produce needs. The result:
demonstrably longer shelf life, better quality for your customers, reduced supply chain waste, and
the confidence to reach distant markets in prime condition.

[Explore Our Technology][38]

## Packaging Solutions

Close to 25 different MA/MH film structures allow us to provide tailor-made solutions for more than
60 different produce types. All films are printable and available in a range of packaging formats.

[XFlow]
[StePacPPC Xflow Logo]

**Roll-Stock Films for Automated Bulk Packing**

High-speed automation-ready films that streamline packing operations while reducing plastic use by
up to 40%. Variable water vapor transmission rates optimize freshness for your specific produce
type.

[Explore Solutions][39]
[Xgo]
[StePacPPC Xgo Logo]

**Retail Packaging Solutions**

Consumer-ready packaging that preserves freshness and drives sales. From lidding films to standing
pouches and preformed bags, our retail solutions extend shelf life while meeting sustainability
expectations and enhancing food safety.

[Explore Solutions][40]
[XTend]
[StePacPPC Xtend Logo]

**Bulk Packaging for Long Term Storage & Shipment**

Industry-leading carton liners, bin liners, and pallet shrouds for over 60 produce types. Our proven
modified atmosphere packaging technology enables sea freight over air, expands storage flexibility,
and delivers produce that arrives as fresh as the day it was packed.

[Explore Solutions][41]
[Xbloom]
[Xbloom]

**Bulk Bags for Cut Flowers**

Specialized bulk packaging engineered for the unique respiration and moisture requirements of
fresh-cut flowers, maintaining quality and extending life throughout the supply chain.

[Explore Solutions][42]

We customize each package to your produce’s needs. Using proprietary film technology and precision

## Sustainability

At our postharvest and polymer laboratory the StePacPPC R&D team is continuously working to develop
the next generation of packaging solutions for shelf life extension of fresh produce to meet market
trends and customer requirements, paying the greatest attention to environmental stewardship.

StePacPPC’s Circular™ product line supports a circular economy and includes fully recyclable
solutions, packaging that contains chemically recycled content, and compostable solutions. All the
films are printable and are available in a range of packaging formats.

[See Our Impact][48]

## A Global Leader in Modified Atmosphere Packaging Solutions for Fresh Produce

StePacPPC is proud to be part of the [PPC Flex family][49], leading the future of functional
flexible packaging together. We make the world a better place by extending fresh produce shelf-life
and reducing global food waste.

With over 30 years of experience in combining postharvest, polymer and packaging expertise, we
address major challenges facing the fresh produce industry: supply chain waste reduction, cost
reduction, market expansion, and enhanced product quality for consumers.

We provide our customers with added value that includes extended seasonality, shipment to remote
destinations via sea freight, reduced waste throughout the supply chain, and enhanced consumer
experience through better quality produce.

Our broad range of modified atmosphere packaging (MAP) solutions preserve fresh produce quality,
reduce supply chain waste and global greenhouse gas emissions.

### Experience. Transformation.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun
Chemical has delivered [over 200 years][114] of color expertise, innovative technology and an
ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop
sustainable solutions to exceed customer expectations and better the world around us. Spread across
17 [research and development][115] centers worldwide, we’ve been granted over 3,000 patents and are
determined to deliver the solutions you need.


## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

#### [ Color Materials ][118]

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.
Combining its pigments with DIC’s polymers for the same industries can create superior benefits and
value for coatings formulators.

#### [ Advanced Materials ][120]

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

[Sun Chemical Security][123] is our dedicated global security solutions business unit focused on
providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

sustainability guides the way we develop, manufacture and distribute products, as well as how we
work with our customers and suppliers.

by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our
emphasis on sustainability continues to be fundamental to our innovation and product development and
is gaining broad support from our customers.

## ABOUT US

Takii began in 1835 as a vegetable seed merchant. It is one of the world's oldest seed companies.
Takii has been breeding better seed varieties to produce vegetables that taste better and flowers
that make people feel better. The passion we put into every seed contributes to better food and a
healthier life.

[ABout 200 years, Crops 75+, Varieties 5500+, Overseas bases in 15+ countries]

### OUR MISSION

Our business is the creation and stable supply of high quality, excellent seed varieties and farm
supplies for a wide range of customers in the world.
In doing so, we commit ourselves to our continuous contribution to food safety and security, sound
health and living, conservation of natural environment and the creation of genuine riches and
cultures throughout the world.
Seeds are not only the source of our innovation, but also the source of our inspiration. We will
continue to develop seed, food and agriculture related business models by which each of the
stakeholders in the value chain will benefit from our innovative products.

# Wrapping Paper Manufacturer, Custom & Wholesale Service

Tena Paper is a China-based wrapping paper manufacturer serving importers, wholesalers, retailers,
brand owners, and packaging buyers who need stable custom production, practical communication, and
reliable bulk order support.

Buyers usually care about more than design. They need consistent paper quality, accurate cutting
size, repeatable printing, suitable GSM, stable rewinding, and export packing that works for
long-distance shipment.

With 12 years of production experience, 20 machines in operation, output up to 130,000 finished
sheets per hour, and export service covering more than 50 countries, we support gift wrapping paper,
Christmas wrapping paper, flower wrapping paper, food wrapping paper, ribbon, and related packaging
supply.

## Smurfit Westrock Atlas

# Corrugated cardboard packaging specialists

## Welcome to Smurfit Westrock Atlas

We are a UK packaging company making a wide range of corrugated cardboard packaging from our base in
Devon. We pride ourselves on delivering competitive prices, clear quotations and excellent service.
To do this we have in house award winning [structural and graphic design teams][21] and state of the
art production equipment.

Corrugated cardboard boxes are a great solution for eCommerce or home delivery packaging as they are
a [sustainable choice for the planet][22], are durable enough to cope in transit and are printed for
an amazing brand experience.

# Welcome to Custom Converting!

## **Custom Converting, Inc. (CCI) is an ISO 9001/2015 Certified contract manufacturer of custom
## parts and components.**

Custom Converting is a 3M Select Converter and specializes in converting, precision slitting, rotary
die cutting, assembly and packaging services, and manufacturing products for businesses throughout
the U.S. and Worldwide. Custom Converting, Inc. (CCI) is an ISO 9001:2015 Certified contract
manufacturer of custom parts and components. Custom Converting, Inc. has been in business since 1983
and is located in Oceanside, California, in San Diego County.

We partner with manufacturing and design engineers, purchasing agents, and production personnel in
providing unique and cost effective manufacturing solutions that meet their needs. We also provide
technical consultation for product design, and the design of effective manufacturing processes. Our
facility is registered with the FDA and we manufacture to cGMP specifications.

Our manufacturing capabilities include
* Precision Die Cutting
* Pouching Services
* Multi-Layer Laminating
* Close Tolerance Slitting
* Assembly and Packaging
* In-line Print

# Reliable, Knowledgeable, & Trustworthy

**3M Select Converter status is a quality certification awarded by 3M Converter Solutions. It is a
difficult qualification to obtain and means that our company is reliable, knowledgeable, and
trustworthy.**

As an authorized 3M™ Select Converter, Fabricator, and Distributor, we remain on the cutting edge of
what’s new in terms of products and processes. We continuously delve into new ways to create
products that meet each customer’s needs. Our versatility and capabilities enable us to die cut
pressure-sensitive adhesives to your exact specifications. We have access to all 3M products, new
technologies, specialists and support to meet your needs.

# Premium Dutch Floral & Decorative
# Importer & Exporter

From fresh cut flowers to refined decorative collections — delivered across Europe with precision,
consistency and market expertise.

[Request Availability][6]
[Dutch tulip fields]

## About MH Flowers

MH Flowers is a Netherlands-based export partner supplying wholesalers, retailers and garden centers
throughout Europe with premium floral and decorative products.

We collaborate closely with trusted growers, nurseries and manufacturers to guarantee quality
control, freshness and stable supply chains. Our approach combines Dutch market expertise with
efficient export logistics tailored to professional buyers. We continuously monitor market trends to
ensure competitive sourcing and product availability throughout the year. Every shipment is handled
with precision and care, reflecting our commitment to long-term business relationships.

## Our Product Divisions

A complete portfolio designed for professional buyers seeking consistency, seasonal innovation and
premium presentation across multiple categories.

### Cut Flowers

Premium roses, tulips and seasonal varieties sourced daily from Dutch auctions and selected growers.

### Garden Plants

Outdoor nursery plants, shrubs and specialty selections for garden centers and landscaping
professionals.

### Home & Indoor Plants

Stylish indoor greenery collections curated for retail chains and interior-focused concepts.

### Floral Arrangements

Ready-made bouquets and custom floral compositions prepared according to market demand.

### Decorative Vases

Glass, ceramic and contemporary design vases complementing modern floral presentations.

### Seasonal Decorations

Holiday and seasonal decorative collections tailored specifically for European retail markets.

## Export & Logistics

Our logistics network ensures temperature-controlled transport throughout Europe, maintaining
freshness and product integrity from grower to destination.

We operate with flexible volumes, consolidated shipments and customized packaging solutions adapted
to each client’s operational needs.

Reliable scheduling. Transparent pricing. Long-term partnerships.
Seamless cross-border transport. Quality assurance at every stage. Built on trust and performance.
Trusted by professionals across Europe.
[Flower Logistics & Transport]

## Partner With MH Flowers

Contact us for weekly availability lists, tailored pricing structures and export conditions adapted
to your market.

[Contact Us][7] MH Flowers | Netherlands

# A Global Leader in Modified Atmosphere Packaging Solutions for Fresh Produce

From berries to beans and fresh cuts, our proprietary modified atmosphere packaging technology
creates the optimal conditions for your high-value produce. As a leading produce packaging supplier
specializing in fresh produce shelf life extension, we help you extend market reach, reduce supply
chain waste, and deliver exceptional freshness; all backed by 30+ years of material science
innovation and postharvest expertise.

[Consult With Us][37]

## We transform how specialty produce reaches the world. Fresher. Sustainably. Profitably.

## Explore StePacPPC’s Technology & Expertise

Our patented modified atmosphere (MA) and modified humidity (MH) films do what standard packaging
cannot — control both gas composition and moisture levels to slow down aging and ripening processes,
inhibit microbial decay and maintain quality. With decades of combined postharvest experience across
60+ produce types, we engineer solutions tailored to your specific produce needs. The result:
demonstrably longer shelf life, better quality for your customers, reduced supply chain waste, and
the confidence to reach distant markets in prime condition.

[Explore Our Technology][38]

## Packaging Solutions

Close to 25 different MA/MH film structures allow us to provide tailor-made solutions for more than
60 different produce types. All films are printable and available in a range of packaging formats.

[XFlow]
[StePacPPC Xflow Logo]

**Roll-Stock Films for Automated Bulk Packing**

High-speed automation-ready films that streamline packing operations while reducing plastic use by
up to 40%. Variable water vapor transmission rates optimize freshness for your specific produce
type.

[Explore Solutions][39]
[Xgo]
[StePacPPC Xgo Logo]

**Retail Packaging Solutions**

Consumer-ready packaging that preserves freshness and drives sales. From lidding films to standing
pouches and preformed bags, our retail solutions extend shelf life while meeting sustainability
expectations and enhancing food safety.

[Explore Solutions][40]
[XTend]
[StePacPPC Xtend Logo]

**Bulk Packaging for Long Term Storage & Shipment**

Industry-leading carton liners, bin liners, and pallet shrouds for over 60 produce types. Our proven
modified atmosphere packaging technology enables sea freight over air, expands storage flexibility,
and delivers produce that arrives as fresh as the day it was packed.

[Explore Solutions][41]
[Xbloom]
[Xbloom]

**Bulk Bags for Cut Flowers**

Specialized bulk packaging engineered for the unique respiration and moisture requirements of
fresh-cut flowers, maintaining quality and extending life throughout the supply chain.

[Explore Solutions][42]

We customize each package to your produce’s needs. Using proprietary film technology and precision
laser perforation, [we optimize O₂ and CO₂ levels][43] to extend shelf life under your specific
supply chain conditions.

destinations via sea freight, reduced waste throughout the supply chain, and enhanced consumer

## ABOUT US

Takii began in 1835 as a vegetable seed merchant. It is one of the world's oldest seed companies.
Takii has been breeding better seed varieties to produce vegetables that taste better and flowers
that make people feel better. The passion we put into every seed contributes to better food and a
healthier life.

[ABout 200 years, Crops 75+, Varieties 5500+, Overseas bases in 15+ countries]

### OUR MISSION

Our business is the creation and stable supply of high quality, excellent seed varieties and farm
supplies for a wide range of customers in the world.
In doing so, we commit ourselves to our continuous contribution to food safety and security, sound
health and living, conservation of natural environment and the creation of genuine riches and
cultures throughout the world.
Seeds are not only the source of our innovation, but also the source of our inspiration. We will
continue to develop seed, food and agriculture related business models by which each of the
stakeholders in the value chain will benefit from our innovative products.

# Wrapping Paper Manufacturer, Custom & Wholesale Service

Tena Paper is a China-based wrapping paper manufacturer serving importers, wholesalers, retailers,
brand owners, and packaging buyers who need stable custom production, practical communication, and
reliable bulk order support.

Buyers usually care about more than design. They need consistent paper quality, accurate cutting
size, repeatable printing, suitable GSM, stable rewinding, and export packing that works for
long-distance shipment.

With 12 years of production experience, 20 machines in operation, output up to 130,000 finished
sheets per hour, and export service covering more than 50 countries, we support gift wrapping paper,
Christmas wrapping paper, flower wrapping paper, food wrapping paper, ribbon, and related packaging
supply.
